items.title: Black sources: Tech's pages vs IWPFT062
items.detail: Tech's SE11, SE21, SE42, SE43 and SE61 pages print the black as "NPC PE90000F (or Spartech B60009 or MDI PE-500)" and similar. IWPFT062 rev 18 lists CR400K NPC PE-B9000F with approved second sources Avient 3800 Black PEC, MDI Black PE-500 and Ampacet 19501 Black PE MB; Spartech B60009 and PolyOne LD-250 are not on it. James, 27 Oct: "we should follow it". The Word file and this page now print the IWPFT062 sources (the source Tech names first stays first). Tech's pages to be updated.

items.detail: Down from 27 formulas in 22 orders (23 Oct, before the 26 Oct rules). Now one formula prints ENGINEER TO SET on 26 Oct: SE21 RP26A15-1 FUA032KS4 (Primary; its Secondary FUA152KS4 has settings). 23 Oct also had SE21 H6AA017-1 FUA031KS5. Neither has been run on SE21. items.title: Winter starts Sunday 1 Nov: no winter settings on file
items.detail: From 1 Nov the rules print your winter Main FUA152WB4 (W%: 8% homopolymer) for graphic WB 4 mm - about 20 orders on Friday's schedule. Every FUA152WB4 / FUA151WB4 recipe on file (Tech's pages and calc sheets, SE13/21/22/24/31/32/43) is the 15% homopolymer one, so the winter name would print with the summer settings. Before Mon 2 Nov: keep Tech's 15% recipe, or set winter settings (8%) per line?

items.title: Products with no Main in the W% Master (last 12 months)
items.detail: Applying the logic to every product scheduled since Oct 2025 (616 products, 1,687 orders): 31 products / 72 orders have no Main - R4 black 8 mm on SE11 (RPP80KS239, 20 orders), bubble KS 5 mm on SE61 (11), JG 4 mm graphic on SE13 (8), WB 10 mm VOIDFORM without reclaim on SE22 (7: the only WB 10 mm Main has reclaim), anti-static pink 2 mm on SE11 (6), opaque WB 3 mm sign blank on SE31 (5), FW 4 mm FR on SE21 (4), UV black 4 mm on SE12 (2), and 9 single orders. Spec R9RDRD (bubble) has no prefix rule.

items.title: Keys with two Mains (last 12 months)
items.detail: KS 3 mm packaging FU0032KS3 or FU0051KS3 (SE11/SE42, 20 orders); KS 6 mm packaging FU0041KS6 or FU0062KS6 (SE21, 2). Decided 26 Oct: NS 10 mm U1 runs FEA001NSA ("U1 is for FEA"); it has no settings on SE22 yet (SE22's FH0001NSA recipe is the anti-static FHA001NSA, UV-N26177A) - 9 orders in 12 months.

items.title: Settings coverage by line (last 12 months)
items.detail: 153 products / 352 orders get a Main with no settings on their line, mostly because Tech's formulation sheets before 23 Sep 2026 are not on file: SE13 FU0031WB4 + FU0014WB4 (51 orders), SE43 FU0031WB4 + FU0014WB4 (39), SE21 FUA032KS4 (37), SE43 FU0032WB3 (33), SE21 FUA032KS6 (16), SE24 RU0022WB4 (12), SE43 FUA152WB4 sign (12), SE23 FU0031WB4 (12), SE21 FUA011EA5 (12), SE31 FU0031WB4 + FU0014WB4 (11). The auger calculation, or Tech's older pages, would fill them.

Orders linked by RUN WITH NEXT (the next order on the line) or RUN WITH <product> (that product's orders on the line) take one formulation; the stricter one wins (sign blank FUA152WB4 over graphic FUA151WB4), noted on the row "RUN WITH <order>: same sheet, same formulation". 26 Oct: SE13 RP26717-1 (RPA40WB3051) runs FUA152WB4 with RP26327-1; SE24 RP26803-2 (RPA40WB3051) and RP26901-1 (RPA40WB3630) run FUA152WB4 with sign blank RP26604-1. The other pairs already matched.

resolved.title: Printed GSM is the billing weight; VOIDFORM runs 5-8% under it
resolved.detail: James, 27 Oct: the GSM on the schedule is for charging the customer. Every board is marked up 3% for the trimmed edge; VOIDFORM is also die cut, another 2%, so 5% is break even, and the plant controls within 3%: "the control range for Voidform is -5% to -8%". The ranges on file fit (631 -> 582-600, 793 -> 729-751, 1052 -> 970-1000). The daily check now reports a range only when it falls outside that band. James, 27 Oct: "you dont have to worry about GSM as for now. In the future we will improve QC entry with another claude code, who will deal with GSM."
